Microsoft WebView2 Loader 1.0.3296.44

Official SDK: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Web.WebView2/1.0.3296.44
Package SHA256: 5b1b19c266ddff33c837ed7965a95bac3dae69b48b5b27f26e5d69f161e9f534

Unmodified Microsoft-signed native loaders from build/native/x86 and x64.
Matches the SDK imported by RAD Studio 13 (37.0).
Copy Win32/WebView2Loader.dll beside a Win32 executable, or Win64/WebView2Loader.dll beside a Win64 executable. Do not mix architectures.
The separately installed Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is also required for Edge rendering.
Redistribution terms and third-party notices are in LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt.
